stateCriteria.VALIDATED_NAME: Exact output adjudicated for its profile and language, independent full-graph interpretation (English counterpart explicitly identified for Spanish), distinct isomers, literal interactive evidence and directed regressions pass.
stateCriteria.SAFE_REJECTION: No local profile name is available or copyable; graph and structural export remain intact. Does not assert a normative name has been resolved.
stateCriteria.PENDING_NORMATIVE_ADJUDICATION: A candidate or naming family lacks an exact profile/language adjudication; it must not be published as a validated name.
stateCriteria.STRUCTURAL_MISMATCH: An independently interpreted published name differs from the full original graph.
stateCriteria.UNVERIFIED: No independent full-identity evidence or conclusive directed checks are available.

spanishEvidencePolicy: Spanish spellings are derived independently from the RSEQ/IUPAC Spanish guide sections 3-7 and 10, including its metilfenil example. OPSIN interprets only the separately adjudicated English counterpart; it is not a Spanish spelling or PIN oracle.
